notifications_query.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated between (datetime(2026-09-27T13:39:00Z) .. datetime(2026-09-28T13:39:00Z)) | where ContainerName_s == 'notifications' | extend job=tostring(column_ifexists('JobName_s',column_ifexists('ContainerJobName_s','unknown'))) | summarize summaries=countif(Log_s contains 'procesados='), processed=sum(toint(extract(@'procesados=(\d+)',1,Log_s))), generated=sum(toint(extract(@'generados=(\d+)',1,Log_s))), sent=sum(toint(extract(@'enviadas=(\d+)',1,Log_s))), retried=sum(toint(extract(@'reintentadas=(\d+)',1,Log_s))), failed=sum(toint(extract(@'fallidas=(\d+)',1,Log_s))), projection_errors=sum(toint(extract(@'errores_proyeccion=(\d+)',1,Log_s))), purged=sum(toint(extract(@'purgadas=(\d+)',1,Log_s))) by job
